caption: The drawing depicts a scene with two naked human figures, one male and one female, standing on either side of a light green tree with blue branches and orange-red spherical fruits. A large dark blue snake is coiled around the tree trunk, with its head extending outward toward the female figure. The background is light beige. The entire scene is bordered with an array of colorful birds and flowers on both the left and right sides. The birds are shown in various shades of green, red, yellow, and brown, while the flowers are primarily red, orange, and yellow with green leaves. Below the central image, there is a rectangular area containing text in black German script, bordered by floral decorations similar to those on the sides. The composition is symmetrical and the color palette is primarily earth tones, greens, reds, yellows, and blues. The drawing is framed with a simple brown border. The name "CHARLOTTE ANGUS" is typed at the bottom right of the paper.
title: Woodcut Vorschrift
